Rape of a young child

Step 2: Select the sentencing range

12. Having determined the levels of culpability and harm, the court should use the following table
to identify the appropriate sentencing range. This is the range of sentences within which the
appropriate headline sentence for the offence appears to fall, having regard to the assessment
of seriousness at step 1.

CULPABILITY

LEVEL A LEVEL B
HARM
LEVEL 1 12 - 14 years’ custody 10 - 12 years’ custody
LEVEL 2 10 - 12 years’ custody 8 - 10 years’ custody
LEVEL 3 8 - 10 years’ custody 7 - 8 years’ custody
Other custodial sentences
